text:
Lena M.: Quick preflight for the multi-region virtual lab (Jun 10). Need final signoff: reg page copy + localized consent, Zoom recording settings (cloud + local fallback + RTMP), SRT captions + JP/FR auto-translate, HubSpot field mapping, calendar invite flow, and post-event deliverables + ownership. Who owns what?
Ravi P.: I can take the reg page copy and localization. Will add a GDPR consent line for EU and a separate CN privacy blurb. Adding hidden inputs: utm_source, cohort, region_code, consent_timestamp. ETA: lunchtime today.
Hector G.: Zoom ops recs: host = Lena, co-host = Nora. Cloud recording on (active speaker), enable SRT and auto-translate to FR/JA, set local fallback (host local) and RTMP fallback to streams.redwood.live if cloud fails. Waiting room enabled until -4m, then open for greenroom. Also enable chat export and participant handraise log.
Nora W.: Sending RTMP fallback snippet for runbook and the S3 ingest prefix. Also propose clip naming and transcript format for editors.
Nora W.: ```
# RTMP fallback for Ops
rtmp://streams.redwood.live/virtual_lab_2026-06-10/fallback
# S3 ingest prefix watched by pipeline:
/events/virtual-lab/2026-06-10/recordings/
# Clip naming: virtual-lab_2026-06-10__{speakerInitials}__{segmentLabel}_v{rev}.mp4
# Transcript: same-base-name.vtt and whisper-full-{meeting_id}.json for automated notes
```
Lena M.: Perfect. For localization: Ravi, can you provide translated consent lines for FR/JP? Also, add a small sentence on the reg page about recordings being used for research & marketing (opt-out checkbox).
Ravi P.: Yep will add translations. For JP we'll use: "イベント資料と関連するコミュニケーションをお送りします。いつでも登録解除できます。" and add an explicit checkbox: "Do not use my recording for marketing."
Hector G.: Ops notes: we'll run an RTMP route test and a caption accuracy check 48h before. Suggest a webhook healthcheck for Zoom recording deliveries; if webhook fails twice, trigger RTMP route and page alert. Example webhook: POST /infra/zoom/webhook/recording with X-Redwood-Sig.
Lena M.: HubSpot mapping? We need cohort segmentation for benchmark narratives and lifecycle mapping to trigger SDR flows. Also ensure UTM capture for channel attribution.
Nora W.: HubSpot headers for CSV import: email, first_name, last_name, utm_source, cohort, region_code, consent_given, consent_timestamp, timezone. Import flow: default lifecycle = "lead"; if consent_given == true and cohort == "enterprise" then set to "marketing_qualified" and queue for SDR assignment. I'll add a property tag: "virtual_lab_jun2026" for source.
Hector G.: Reminder: include meeting metadata in recorded filenames for easier replay ingest. We'll add meeting_id and start_ts to the manifest. Editors: expect raw files + whisper JSON in ~36h, VTT + 3 highlight clips (90-150s each) in 72h, full edit + timestamps in 7 days. Who takes clips?
Lena M.: I'll own highlight brief and social snippets. Nora can own the clip exports & S3 uploads. Hector will monitor ingestion and alert if any prefixes are missing. Ravi will handle localized thanks-email and calendar invite copy.
Nora W.: Ill export clips and upload to s3://redwood-events/virtual-lab/2026-06-10/. Ill post the clip sheet with timestamps, watch-time recommendations, and suggested CTAs. Will tag Sales for demo CTA viewers.
Ravi P.: After upload Ill run the HubSpot import (within 24h) and kick enrichment for enterprise cohort. SDR outreach to start 48-72h after highlight pack published. Rule: if watch_time_pct >= 50% OR clicked_demo_cta then set lifecycle to "sales_contact".
Hector G.: Ops test schedule: RTMP + webhook tests tomorrow 9am PT, caption accuracy sample at 10am PT, and a failover dry-run at 2pm PT. Will log status in the runbook.
webinar-bot: Reminder: "Multi-Region Virtual Lab" scheduled 2026-06-10T16:00:00Z. Cloud recording enabled; SRT captions ON.
Lena M.: Final asks: Ravi confirm localized consent lines and the thank-you page translations, Nora confirm S3 path after test upload, Hector confirm webhook healthcheck script in runbook. If all green I'll publish the Notion runbook and pin it. :rocket:
Ravi P.: Translations done, uploading to staging now.
Nora W.: Test upload scheduled after 11am PT, will confirm s3 path and post sample.
Hector G.: Tests scheduled and infra alerted. Will post results here.
Lena M.: Thanks all  closing thread  will publish final runbook and tag owners. :white_check_mark:
